nvitk.gui.core.log_panel

.. py:module:: nvitk.gui.core.log_panel

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

.. py:function:: set_log_widget(widget: qtpy.QtWidgets.QPlainTextEdit | None) -> None

   Register *widget* as the log panel that :func:`gui_log` appends to (module-level singleton).


.. py:function:: gui_log(message: str, *, error: bool = False) -> None

   Append a timestamped log line to the registered log widget (if any) and stdout.


.. py:function:: build_log_dock_widget() -> qtpy.QtWidgets.QWidget

   Bottom dock: plain-text log of tools and pipelines.
